correctness.rationale: The full face set is exhaustively constructed by induction on 16-bit masks. Each of 32 explicitly listed collapse pairs has the codimension-one and unique-coface property in the actual current simplicial complex. The final 16-vertex,48-edge,32-triangle subcomplex is checked to have connected one-skeleton, exactly two incident triangles per edge, a connected cyclic link at each vertex, coherent global orientation, and Euler characteristic zero. Closed orientable surface classification implies the torus, so homotopy and integral homology/cup conclusions follow.

value.rationale: The one-symbol constraint complex of the first nontrivial Sudoku graph is a natural object joining puzzle completion, independence complexes and topological graph theory. Its torus fundamental group and nonzero degree-one cup product go beyond the known coloring counts and spectrum and contrast with the sphere-wedge homotopy type of the unconstrained four-by-four rook/chessboard complex. An exact explicit collapse provides a reusable test case for block constraints and a non-wedge topological example; no larger-order theorem is claimed.
